01 / THE CHALLENGE

The challenge

A healthcare learning product has to make sense to both learners and institutions. The challenge was to understand their needs before committing to a product direction.

02 / THE APPROACH

The approach

Conducted more than 100 conversations with doctors, hospitals and students, alongside over 370 medical-student validations. Converted learner and institutional feedback into product requirements and pilot workflows.

03 / WHAT CHANGED

What changed

Research insights informed two product pivots. The work connected discovery to a more specific direction for an AI patient-simulation platform; learning-outcome metrics are not reported.

THE TAKEAWAY

Changing direction is useful when it is grounded in evidence. Discovery earns its place when it changes what gets built.
